title: HackHarvard Saturday night: instant plan, meet in the middle
notes: The HUNGRY_FLOW.md opening scenario, on HackHarvard Saturday (Oct 17 2026, 6:30pm, no dinner served). Aiden's unaddressed 'where are we eating' arrives with no plan and notice mode off, so Homi must stay silent apart from the one-time intro. The food label is still true: the intent is real, but Homi isn't invited. Bea's '@homi where should we eat' starts an instant plan (today, around now) directly in collecting_place, with no date options, so no message has a votes map. Chidi's 'somewhere near here' is vague, so Homi asks once 'Which neighborhood? I never use your location.' Devi names Harvard Sq and Emre names Allston, so Homi searches around the midpoint and the header says it's halfway between them. Fatima: vegetarian plus a pizza veto. Cuisines: dumplings 3, ramen 1, tacos 1, so no compromise. Budget '$$'. Bea's 'homi go' closes collection early (before every member has given a cuisine). Votes close when a majority of the answerers has voted for #2 (Aiden's text vote may arrive after the close; it is still labeled). Instant plans have no reminder offer and no date lock, so lockedBy is null and finalDay is today (sat). The bill is split after dinner, then a fast-forward past event+24h purges silently.

otherChecks: Aiden's first message gets only the one-time intro; Homi does not start a flow from it (no plan, not addressed, notice mode off).
Bea's mention starts an instant plan dated today (Sat Oct 17) and asks 'What are we feeling? Cuisine, budget, and roughly where?' with no date options.
Chidi's 'near here' triggers exactly one 'Which neighborhood? I never use your location.' (or equivalent); Homi never asks for device location.
Harvard Sq + Allston produce a midpoint search, and the recommendation header says 'halfway between Harvard Sq and Allston'.
No pizza place among the 3 options; vegetarian is applied as a filter or a 'check: vegetarian' note; all 3 options are dumpling/Chinese spots at or under $$ (est.).
Opening hours are evaluated for now (Sat ~6:40pm) because this is an instant plan; unknown hours are shown as 'hours unknown'.
Walking time is labeled '... min walk' and computed locally (no routing API call).
The places lookup egress contains only cuisine tags, a price band and a derived coordinate: no 'harvard sq'/'allston' text, no names, no phone numbers.
Option #2 wins. The closing message posts its address once, with no reminder offer (instant plan), and the plan is confirmed.
'homi split 87.60 6 ways' replies '$14.60 each for 6 people (tip not included)' or equivalent.
After event + 24h the plan is purged silently; 'homi what do you know' then shows no plan data.
Neither 617 555 0163 nor bea.l@example.com appears in any log line.
